name: Excelsior
summary: In Booty Bay, Drizzlik is ready for the last piece of the Excelsior boots. He needs an elder saltwater crocolisk skin for their outer layer.

sections.title: The Outer Layer
sections.body:
Drizzlik has finished the boots’ inner layer. For the outside, he uses the finest elder crocolisk skins. They are tougher and give the Excelsior designs and accents a better surface. Only an elder saltwater crocolisk skin fits his plan.

Finding one is difficult. Elders come out only to guard other saltwater crocolisks. Drizzlik has also read that saltwater crocolisk numbers are dwindling, which worries him for his business.

sections.title: Drizzlik's Thanks
sections.body: Drizzlik can fill the order and send it early to Director Riddlevox aboard the next boat bound for Undermine. He has made extras and gives you a pair for your trouble. No boot, he insists, is as fine as the Excelsior line.

faq.answer: Drizzlik makes the Excelsior line of boots in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does Drizzlik need an elder saltwater crocolisk skin?
faq.answer: Drizzlik says elder skins are tougher and give the Excelsior designs and accents a better surface. Only an elder saltwater crocolisk skin fits his plan.

faq.q: Why are elder saltwater crocolisks hard to find?
faq.answer: Elder saltwater crocolisks come out only to defend other saltwater crocolisks, Drizzlik says.

faq.q: What concern does Drizzlik have about saltwater crocolisks?
faq.answer: Drizzlik has read that saltwater crocolisk numbers are dwindling, a concern for his business.
